notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Today we will be releasing version 1.1, the latest main iteration of the game since release, over the past week we have had a number of minor updates fixing small bugs running from version 1.01 - 1.09.

Today is our latest stable version with all known bugs fixed.

This resolves many errors in different areas, but some of these bugs may still occur for games in progress, to ensure the best possible game without bugs we recommend starting a new game. This is to ensure you can access all characters that were previously bugged slightly on release.

[h1]The Games Future[/h1]

Also there is a discussion on the community hub about a possible sequel, or new content for the game via DLC or free updates, if interested in seeing the story expanded or continue, check out the community hub to join in.

notes.title: Release Discount
notes.notes:
Now that the game is officially released we hope people will consider ordering it, to that end Starlight Drifter will remain at its lower price and will be part of the current Steam Summer Sale until the end, giving players a last chance to get the game at the lower Early Access price with discount.

The games discount and price however will increase to its full retail amount as soon as the current Summer Sale Ends. So be sure to consider ordering it now.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Live
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that todays update takes us to release version 1.0. It includes the final image scenes that were missing and as usual we have fixed all reported bugs on the discussion hub.

We now consider the game completed and ready for full release on steam and on other platforms. As all images and content have now been implemented.

We are very happy that we continued to work on the game to make something we can be proud of that keeps within it;

* Character Creation
* An open map to explore
* Freedom of choice
* Multiple epilogues based on your actions
* Multiple endings
* Romance

And lots more besides. We hope you all enjoy the game.

[b][i]N.b. Lastly, please be aware that at the start of July we will be increasing the games price to its full price we plan to release the game on, and then the game will officially leave Early Access on July 6th.[/i][/b]

[i](with the exception of one for the games main epilogue/ending

notes.title: Version 0.99.04
notes.notes:
The latest update for Starlight Drifter is now live, this corrects several issues with the Koria character and relationship with her on board the ship.

First it corrects an error that occasionally occurs when you meet her, whereby she would not appear on the starlight as a crew member afterwards.

Please note that while we have corrected this bug, if you have already gone past this point in the game Koria will not suddenly appear, instead if you play the mission where she appears from this point on the bug will not occur and she will join the crew as normal.

In addition once this was resolved we found some missing sprite images of Koria and so we also fixed these issues in this update.

notes.title: Version 0.99.03
notes.notes:
Today's update is technically a small one, but an important one.

Today we have implemented an update that resolves all known Sprite Error bugs, that are generally called 'paper cutout' bugs. This is a bug where instead of a character sprite appearing a flat siloutte default image appears instead.

This update resolves all known and reported paper cutout sprite errors.
As well as other sprite errors within the game.
Allowing us to focus on other aspects such as the games Achievements and Trading Cards.

[i]If after this point you encounter any errors with character sprites, paper cutout or otherwise please report them on the community hub. When doing so please also quote a line of text from the dialogue box, so that we can properly match the error within the thousands of lines of code that make up the game, for a quicker resolution of the error. But hopefully there will be none after this point.[/i]

[b][i]Remember the current version 0.99.03 will appear on the main menu, ensure the game is up to date before reporting an error, to prevent us looking for an error that was already resolved.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Version 0.99
notes.notes:
Version 0.99 is now live.

We have worked hard over the past few months, updating the game and trying to ensure as much of the original plans remain within the game.

Whilst we did have to make some compromises here and there, most of the games main features remain intact:

1. Character Creation Remains
2. Crew Romances Remain
3. Open World Story Telling Remain

Essentially we have edited the entire script, written extra content where needed and fully coded the game with backgrounds, character sprites and even cg illustrations. 

[h1][b]Warning: This update will break all existing save games,
so please delete them and start the game fresh to avoid game crashes![/b][/h1]

There are still a few things to fix and a few more illustrations to add, but the game we believe is stable and as we stated before 99% complete.

We will continue to post smaller updates with remaining art scenes, bug fixes and additional content over the coming weeks in preparation for the games full release.

In addition we will be looking to launch the games steam achievements and trading cards very soon as well.

notes.title: Update 14 - Reversion, Dedication & apologies
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Today we are reverting the game back to a previous update, update #14. Which will see a variety of content being reintroduced to the game, we will also be looking to use this as a basis moving forward.

I (Dharker Himself) will be taking over development of this game, and I will be looking to dedicate my time to it until it is finished, I will be doing weekly updates, you an expect to see save breaking updates pretty much every week for the for-seeable future as I rewrite the script whilst coding changes.

My aim is simple, create what I wanted Starlight Drifter to be when it was started two years ago, I hope you will all come along for the ride.

That being said, I have also requested steam re-add the Refunds anytime for anyone who wants to jettison themselves and come back to it when its out of early access, I do not know when that will be other than when the game is ready. I will advise in a future update when that option is live once more.

This isn't a changelog as such, but here are my notes on changes:

1. Re-added gender select
2. Re-added character creation (hair, eyes, clothing, stance)
3. Re-added scripting as of update 14.

Thank you, next update is next week.
